Translation: O Allah, I ask You by the keys of the unseen
Which no one knows except You

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَنْ
Translation: To send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and ...
O Allah, You are the Guardian of my blessings
And the One capable of fulfilling my requests
So I ask You by the right of Muhammad and his family
Peace be upon him and them
That You fulfill it for me
